# *Basic summary of guideline level details* 
```{r}
# Unique Guidelines 
number_unique_guide <- study %>% 
  distinct(study_id) %>% 
  nrow() ##  

# Unique Checklist
number_unique_checklist <- data %>% 
distinct(checklist) %>% 
  nrow() ##

# overall cumulative counts
guide_per_year <- study %>%
  filter(!is.na(year)) %>%
  distinct(year, study_id) %>%
  count(year, name = "n") %>%
  complete(year = full_seq(year, 1), fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(cum_n = cumsum(n))

  
```

```{r}
# settings
lollipop_years <- c(2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020, 2025)

pal <- c(
  "Original" = "#54478c",
  "Extension" = "#048ba8",
  "Update" = "#16db93",
  "Translation" = "#f29e4c"
)

# clean guideline type labels first
guide_type_base <- study %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(guideline_extension)) %>%
  distinct(year, study_id, guideline_extension) %>%
  mutate(
    guideline_extension = tolower(guideline_extension),
    guideline_extension = case_when(
      guideline_extension %in% c("original", "origional") ~ "Original",
      guideline_extension == "update" ~ "Update",
      guideline_extension == "extension" ~ "Extension",
      guideline_extension == "translation" ~ "Translation",
      
      TRUE ~ str_to_title(guideline_extension)
    )
  )

# order guideline types by oldest first appearance
guideline_levels <- guide_type_base %>%
  group_by(guideline_extension) %>%
  summarise(first_year = min(year), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(first_year, guideline_extension) %>%
  pull(guideline_extension)

legend_order <- guideline_levels

# cumulative counts by guideline type
guide_type_year <- guide_type_base %>%
  mutate(
    guideline_extension = factor(guideline_extension, levels = guideline_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(year, guideline_extension, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    guideline_extension,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(guideline_extension, year) %>%
  group_by(guideline_extension) %>%
  mutate(cum_n = cumsum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# smooth each category separately
smooth_type_year <- guide_type_year %>%
  group_by(guideline_extension) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    x_seq <- seq(min(.x$year), max(.x$year), length.out = 500)
    spline_fn <- splinefun(.x$year, .x$cum_n, method = "monoH.FC")

    tibble(
      year = x_seq,
      cum_n = spline_fn(x_seq)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# lollipop labels from overall totals
lollipop_data <- guide_per_year %>%
  filter(year %in% lollipop_years)

max_cum <- max(guide_per_year$cum_n, na.rm = TRUE)
offset <- max_cum * 0.018
label_offset <- max_cum * 0.03

count_cum_type <- ggplot() +
  geom_area(
    data = smooth_type_year,
    aes(x = year, y = cum_n, fill = guideline_extension),
    position = "stack",
    color = NA,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = lollipop_data,
    aes(x = year, xend = year, y = 0, yend = cum_n + offset),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = lollipop_data,
    aes(x = year, y = cum_n + offset),
    color = "black",
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = lollipop_data,
    aes(x = year, y = cum_n + offset + label_offset, label = comma(cum_n)),
    vjust = 0,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.3,
    color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pal,
    breaks = legend_order,
    name = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      ncol = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1, colour = NA),
      keyheight = unit(0.55, "cm"),
      keywidth = unit(0.55, "cm")
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = lollipop_years,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 60, by = 10),
    labels = comma,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 60),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "a) Grouped by reporting guideline type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.03, 0.97),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = alpha("white", 0.9),
      color = "grey70"
    ),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10.5),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.08, "cm"),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 12.5,
      face = "bold",
      color = "black",
      hjust = 0
    ),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 6, 12)
  )

count_cum_type
```

```{r}
# settings
lollipop_years <- c(2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020, 2025)
```

```{r}
# settings
lollipop_years <- c(2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020, 2025)

pal <- c(
  "Systematic reviews" = "#54478c",
  "Qualitative reviews" = "#048ba8",
  "Abstract" = "#16db93",
  "Literature Search" = "#b9e769",
  "Scoping reviews" = "#efea5a",
  "Bibliometrics" = "#f29e4c"
)

# clean methodology labels first
methodology_base <- study %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(methodology_category)) %>%
  distinct(year, study_id, methodology_category) %>%
  mutate(
    methodology_group = str_squish(str_to_lower(methodology_category)),
    methodology_group = case_when(
      str_detect(methodology_group, "scoping review|scoping reviews|systematic map") ~ "Scoping reviews",
      str_detect(methodology_group, "abstracts") ~ "Abstract",
      methodology_group == "search strategies" ~ "Literature Search",
      str_detect(methodology_group, "qualitative|meta-ethnography|mixed-methods|realist review|meta-narrative review|meta-epidemiology") ~ "Qualitative reviews",
      str_detect(methodology_group, "systematic review|systematic reviews|meta-analyses|overview of systematic reviews|rapid review|living systematic reviews") ~ "Systematic reviews",
      str_detect(methodology_group, "bibliometrics") ~ "Bibliometrics"
    )
  )

# order methodology groups by oldest first appearance
methodology_levels <- methodology_base %>%
  group_by(methodology_group) %>%
  summarise(first_year = min(year), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(first_year, methodology_group) %>%
  pull(methodology_group)

legend_order <- methodology_levels

# cumulative counts by grouped methodology
methodology_year <- methodology_base %>%
  mutate(
    methodology_group = factor(methodology_group, levels = methodology_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(year, methodology_group, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    methodology_group,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(methodology_group, year) %>%
  group_by(methodology_group) %>%
  mutate(cum_n = cumsum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# smooth each methodology group separately
smooth_methodology_year <- methodology_year %>%
  group_by(methodology_group) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    x_seq <- seq(min(.x$year), max(.x$year), length.out = 500)
    spline_fn <- splinefun(.x$year, .x$cum_n, method = "monoH.FC")

    tibble(
      year = x_seq,
      cum_n = spline_fn(x_seq)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# overall cumulative totals for lollipops
guide_per_year <- study %>%
  filter(!is.na(year)) %>%
  distinct(year, study_id) %>%
  count(year, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(cum_n = cumsum(n))

lollipop_data <- guide_per_year %>%
  filter(year %in% lollipop_years)

max_cum <- max(guide_per_year$cum_n, na.rm = TRUE)
offset <- max_cum * 0.018
label_offset <- max_cum * 0.03

count_cum_methodology <- ggplot() +
  geom_area(
    data = smooth_methodology_year,
    aes(x = year, y = cum_n, fill = methodology_group),
    position = "stack",
    color = NA,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = lollipop_data,
    aes(x = year, xend = year, y = 0, yend = cum_n + offset),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = lollipop_data,
    aes(x = year, y = cum_n + offset),
    color = "black",
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = lollipop_data,
    aes(x = year, y = cum_n + offset + label_offset, label = comma(cum_n)),
    vjust = 0,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.3,
    color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pal,
    breaks = legend_order,
    name = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      ncol = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1, colour = NA),
      keyheight = unit(0.55, "cm"),
      keywidth = unit(0.55, "cm")
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = lollipop_years,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 60, by = 10),
    labels = comma,

  ) +
  coord_cartesian(

  ) +

  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
```

```{r}
figure_all <- (
  count_cum_type /
  count_cum_discipline /
  count_cum_methodology
) & 
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(14, 10, 8, 10)
  )

final_figure <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
  patchwork::patchworkGrob(figure_all),
  left = grid::textGrob(
    "Cumulative number of reporting guidelines",
    rot = 90,
    gp = grid::gpar(
      fontsize = 13,
      fontface = "bold",
      col = "black"
    )
  ),
  bottom = grid::textGrob(
    "Publication year",
    gp = grid::gpar(
      fontsize = 13,
      fontface = "bold",
      col = "black"
    )
  )
)

grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(final_figure)

 ggsave(
  filename = here::here("figures", "figure_all_three.jpg"),
   plot     = final_figure,
   width    = 25,
   height   = 30,
  units    = "cm",
  dpi      = 300,
  bg       = "white"
 )
```

# *Basic summary of item level details*

## Total items, total concepts and unique concepts

### Total items
```{r}

length(data$reporting_item)  # Number of items

# Number of items per study/guideline
items_per_checklist <- data %>%
  group_by(checklist) %>%
  summarise(n_items = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Mean and range across studies/guidelines
mean(items_per_checklist$n_items)
range(items_per_checklist$n_items)

# Or all in one summary line
items_per_checklist %>%
  summarise(
    mean_items  = mean(n_items),
    min_items   = min(n_items),
    max_items   = max(n_items),
    sd_items    = sd(n_items)
  )

col_point <- "#54478c"
col_stem  <- "#cfc8e8"
col_text  <- "black"

section_order <- c(
  "Other Information",
  "Discussion",
  "Results",
  "Methodology",
  "Introduction",
  "Abstract",
  "Title"
)

item_per_section <- data %>%
  group_by(standardised_section) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

item_per_section_plot <- item_per_section %>%
  filter(!is.na(standardised_section)) %>%
  mutate(
    standardised_section = str_squish(as.character(standardised_section))
  ) %>%
  group_by(standardised_section) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    standardised_section = factor(
      standardised_section,
      levels = section_order
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(standardised_section))

max_n <- max(item_per_section_plot$n, na.rm = TRUE)
value_pad <- max_n * 0.035

count_items_section <- ggplot(
  item_per_section_plot,
  aes(x = n, y = standardised_section)
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = n, y = standardised_section, yend = standardised_section),
    linewidth = 2.2,
    colour = col_stem,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 4.8,
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 1,
    fill = col_point,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = n,
      y = standardised_section,
      label = comma(n)
    ),
    nudge_y = 0.3,
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 0,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.5,
    colour = col_text
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of items",
    y = "Section of the manuscript"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.35),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 12.5,
      face = "bold",
      color = "black",
      hjust = 0
    ),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
  )
```

### Reporting items for each section
```{r}
study_lookup <- study %>%
  distinct(study_id, year, DOI) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ stri_enc_toutf8(.x, validate = TRUE)))

tables_by_section <- data %>%
  left_join(study_lookup, by = "study_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(standardised_section)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.character), ~ stri_enc_toutf8(.x, validate = TRUE)),
    standardised_section = str_squish(as.character(standardised_section)),
    standardised_section = case_when(
      str_to_lower(standardised_section) == "other" ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ standardised_section
    ),
    standardised_section = factor(standardised_section, levels = section_order),
    DOI = na_if(str_squish(as.character(DOI)), "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(standardised_section)) %>%
  select(standardised_section, reporting_item, study_id, year, DOI) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(standardised_section, reporting_item, study_id, year) %>%
  summarise(
    DOI = paste(sort(unique(DOI[!is.na(DOI)])), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(standardised_section, year, reporting_item) %>%
  group_nest(standardised_section) %>%
  mutate(
    sheet_name = as.character(standardised_section),
    sheet_name = stri_enc_toutf8(sheet_name, validate = TRUE),
    sheet_name = substr(sheet_name, 1, 31),
    sheet_name = make.unique(sheet_name)
  )

wb <- createWorkbook()

iwalk(seq_len(nrow(tables_by_section)), function(i, ...) {
  addWorksheet(wb, tables_by_section$sheet_name[i])
  writeData(wb, tables_by_section$sheet_name[i], tables_by_section$data[[i]])
})

saveWorkbook(wb, file.path("data", "tables_by_section.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Helper to clean and convert to valid UTF-8
clean_column <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    x %>%
      stri_enc_toutf8() %>%
      stri_replace_all_regex("[^\\x00-\\x7F]", "")
  } else {
    x
  }
}

study_year <- study %>%
  distinct(study_id, year)

df2 <- data %>%
  left_join(study_year, by = "study_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(standardised_section)) %>%
  mutate(
    standardised_section = str_squish(as.character(standardised_section)),
    standardised_section = case_when(
      str_to_lower(standardised_section) == "other" ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ standardised_section
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(standardised_section)) %>%
  select(standardised_section, reporting_item, study_id, year) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), clean_column)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(standardised_section, year, reporting_item)

# Force UTF-8 on character columns
df2 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~stri_enc_toutf8(.)))

# Map all section names to the desired canonical names and order
df2 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(
    section_key = case_when(
      str_to_lower(standardised_section) == "title" ~ "Title",
      str_to_lower(standardised_section) == "abstract" ~ "Abstract",
      str_to_lower(standardised_section) %in% c("intro", "introduction") ~ "Introduction",
      str_to_lower(standardised_section) == "methods" ~ "Methods",
      str_to_lower(standardised_section) == "results" ~ "Results",
      str_to_lower(standardised_section) == "discussion" ~ "Discussion",
      str_to_lower(standardised_section) == "other" ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

tables_by_section <- split(df2, df2$section_key)

# Force the desired sheet order
ordered_sections <- c("Title", "Abstract", "Introduction", "Methods", "Results", "Discussion", "Other")
tables_by_section <- tables_by_section[ordered_sections][!sapply(tables_by_section, is.null)]

# Remove any remaining NA/named sections
tables_by_section <- tables_by_section[!is.na(names(tables_by_section))]

wb <- createWorkbook()

# ensure names are canonical and in order
ordered_sections <- c("Title","Abstract","Introduction","Methods","Results","Discussion","Other")

# build named list with guaranteed names (even if empty)
tables_by_section_named <- setNames(
  lapply(ordered_sections, function(sec) {
    if (sec %in% names(tables_by_section)) {
      tables_by_section[[sec]]
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }),
  ordered_sections
)

# keep only non-NULL entries
tables_by_section_named <- tables_by_section_named[!sapply(tables_by_section_named, is.null)]

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (sheet_name in names(tables_by_section_named)) {
  df_sheet <- tables_by_section_named[[sheet_name]] %>%
    select(reporting_item, year, study_id) %>%
    arrange(reporting_item, year) %>%
    rename(item = reporting_item)

  # sanitize sheet name
  sn <- substr(sheet_name, 1, 31)
  sn <- gsub("[:\\\\/?*\\[\\]]", "_", sn)
  if (sn == "" || is.na(sn)) sn <- "Section"

  addWorksheet(wb, sn)
  writeDataTable(wb, sheet = sn, x = df_sheet)
  freezePane(wb, sn, firstRow = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, sn, cols = 1:3, widths = "auto")
}

saveWorkbook(wb, file = file.path("data", "tables_by_section.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Readability 
```{r}
# =========================================================
# 1) helper functions
# =========================================================

calc_ttr <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  dplyr::n_distinct(x) / length(x)
}

calc_mattr <- function(x, window = 10) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n == 0) return(NA_real_)
  if (n < window) return(calc_ttr(x))
  starts <- seq_len(n - window + 1)
  mean(purrr::map_dbl(starts, ~ calc_ttr(x[.x:(.x + window - 1)])))
}

squeeze01 <- function(y, n = length(y)) {
  ((y * (n - 1)) + 0.5) / n
}

# =========================================================
# 2) build item-level dataset with year + study_id
# =========================================================

items <- data  %>% # total is 2,191 as we remove languages other than english
  filter(!is.na(reporting_item), !is.na(study_id)) %>%
  mutate(reporting_item = str_squish(as.character(reporting_item))) %>%
  filter(reporting_item != "") %>%
  left_join(
    study %>%
      transmute(
        study_id,
        year = as.integer(year)
      ),
    by = "study_id",
    multiple = "all"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(year)) %>%
  distinct(study_id, year, reporting_item, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(year, study_id, reporting_item) %>%
  mutate(item_id = row_number())

# =========================================================
# 3) tokenization for MATTR
# =========================================================

item_tokens <- items %>%
  tidytext::unnest_tokens(word, reporting_item)

lexdiv_stats <- item_tokens %>%
  group_by(item_id) %>%
  summarise(
    token_count = n(),
    unique_tokens = n_distinct(word),
    mattr_10 = calc_mattr(word, window = 10),
    .groups = "drop"
  )



token_count_stats <- lexdiv_stats %>%
  summarise(
    n_items = n(),
    mean_tokens = mean(token_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_tokens = sd(token_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_tokens = median(token_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_tokens = min(token_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_tokens = max(token_count, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

token_count_stats_fmt <- token_count_stats %>%
  mutate(
    mean_sd_n = sprintf(
      "%.2f (SD %.2f), n = %d items",
      mean_tokens, sd_tokens, n_items
    )
  )

token_count_stats_fmt

# =========================================================
# 4) POS tagging for lexical density
# =========================================================

if (!file.exists("english-ewt-ud-2.5-191206.udpipe")) {
  model_info <- udpipe_download_model(language = "english")
  file_model <- model_info$file_model
} else {
  file_model <- "english-ewt-ud-2.5-191206.udpipe"
}

ud_model <- udpipe_load_model(file_model)

anno <- udpipe_annotate(
  ud_model,
  x = items$reporting_item,
  doc_id = items$item_id
)

anno_df <- as.data.frame(anno) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    doc_id = as.integer(doc_id),
    token = str_squish(as.character(token)),
    upos = as.character(upos)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(token), token != "", !is.na(upos))

content_upos <- c("NOUN", "PROPN", "VERB", "ADJ", "ADV")

lexical_density_stats <- anno_df %>%
  group_by(doc_id) %>%
  summarise(
    token_count_pos = n(),
    content_token_count = sum(upos %in% content_upos),
    lexical_density = content_token_count / token_count_pos,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(item_id = doc_id)

# =========================================================
# 5) combine modeling dataset
# =========================================================

item_metrics <- items %>%
  left_join(lexdiv_stats, by = "item_id") %>%
  left_join(lexical_density_stats, by = "item_id") %>%
  select(
    item_id,
    checklist_item_id,
    study_id,
    year,
    reporting_item,
    token_count,
    unique_tokens,
    mattr_10,
    token_count_pos,
    content_token_count,
    lexical_density
  )

model_dat <- item_metrics %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(study_id),
    !is.na(year),
    !is.na(mattr_10),
    !is.na(lexical_density)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    study_id = factor(study_id),
    year = as.numeric(year),
    year_c = year - mean(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    mattr_beta = squeeze01(mattr_10),
    lexical_density_beta = squeeze01(lexical_density)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    mattr_beta > 0, mattr_beta < 1,
    lexical_density_beta > 0, lexical_density_beta < 1
  )

# =========================================================
# 6) basis size
# =========================================================

n_years <- dplyr::n_distinct(model_dat$year_c)
k_year <- if (n_years >= 5) min(10, n_years - 1) else max(3, n_years - 1)

# =========================================================
# 7) priors
# =========================================================

priors_beta_gam <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds")
)

# =========================================================
# 8) fit models
# =========================================================

fit_mattr <- brm(
  mattr_beta ~ s(year_c, k = k_year) + (1 | study_id),
  data = model_dat,
  family = Beta(link = "logit", link_phi = "log"),
  prior = priors_beta_gam,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  seed = 1234,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.995, max_treedepth = 15),
  file = "fit_mattr_brms_gam_studyid"
)

fit_lexdens <- brm(
  lexical_density_beta ~ s(year_c, k = k_year) + (1 | study_id),
  data = model_dat,
  family = Beta(link = "logit", link_phi = "log"),
  prior = priors_beta_gam,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  seed = 1234,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.995, max_treedepth = 15),
  file = "fit_lexdens_brms_gam_studyid"
)



# =========================================================
# 10) save objects
# =========================================================

dir.create(here::here("R.data"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(items, file = here::here("R.data", "items_with_year.rds"))
saveRDS(item_metrics, file = here::here("R.data", "item_metrics_for_brms.rds"))
saveRDS(model_dat, file = here::here("R.data", "model_dat_mattr_lexdens.rds"))
saveRDS(fit_mattr, file = here::here("R.data", "fit_mattr_brms_gam_studyid.rds"))
saveRDS(fit_lexdens, file = here::here("R.data", "fit_lexdens_brms_gam_studyid.rds"))
```

```{r}

year_mean <- mean(model_dat$year)  # must match the centering used when fitting


avg_slope <- function(fit, year_min, year_max, step = 0.1) {
  grid <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = step)
  newdata <- tibble(year_c = grid - year_mean)

  draws <- posterior_epred(fit, newdata = newdata, re_formula = NA)  # draws x grid

  d_year <- diff(grid)
  slope_draws_by_gap <- (draws[, -1, drop = FALSE] - draws[, -ncol(draws), drop = FALSE]) /
    matrix(d_year, nrow = nrow(draws), ncol = length(d_year), byrow = TRUE)

  avg_slope_draws <- rowMeans(slope_draws_by_gap)  # one avg slope per posterior draw

  tibble(
    mean_slope_per_year = mean(avg_slope_draws),
    lower_95 = as.numeric(quantile(avg_slope_draws, 0.025)),
    upper_95 = as.numeric(quantile(avg_slope_draws, 0.975))
  )
}

# =========================================================
# Helper 2: endpoint-to-endpoint total & annualized change
# =========================================================

endpoint_change <- function(fit, year_min, year_max) {
  newdata <- tibble(year_c = c(year_min, year_max) - year_mean)
  draws <- posterior_epred(fit, newdata = newdata, re_formula = NA)  # draws x 2

  total_draws <- draws[, 2] - draws[, 1]
  per_year_draws <- total_draws / (year_max - year_min)

  tibble(
    total_change      = mean(total_draws),
    total_lower_95    = as.numeric(quantile(total_draws, 0.025)),
    total_upper_95    = as.numeric(quantile(total_draws, 0.975)),
    per_year_change   = mean(per_year_draws),
    per_year_lower_95 = as.numeric(quantile(per_year_draws, 0.025)),
    per_year_upper_95 = as.numeric(quantile(per_year_draws, 0.975))
  )
}

# =========================================================
# MATTR
# =========================================================

yr_min <- min(model_dat$year)
yr_max <- max(model_dat$year)

mattr_avg_slope   <- avg_slope(fit_mattr, yr_min, yr_max)
mattr_endpoints   <- endpoint_change(fit_mattr, yr_min, yr_max)

cat("\n--- MATTR ---\n")
cat("Average marginal slope (per year):\n"); print(round(mattr_avg_slope, 4))
cat("Endpoint-to-endpoint change (", yr_min, "to", yr_max, "):\n")
print(round(mattr_endpoints, 4))

# =========================================================
# Lexical density (overall)
# =========================================================

lexdens_avg_slope <- avg_slope(fit_lexdens, yr_min, yr_max)
lexdens_endpoints <- endpoint_change(fit_lexdens, yr_min, yr_max)

cat("\n--- Lexical density (overall) ---\n")
cat("Average marginal slope (per year):\n"); print(round(lexdens_avg_slope, 4))
cat("Endpoint-to-endpoint change (", yr_min, "to", yr_max, "):\n")
print(round(lexdens_endpoints, 4))

# =========================================================
# Lexical density, split pre-/post-2020
# (supports the "particularly after 2020" claim)
# =========================================================

if (yr_min < 2020 && yr_max > 2020) {
  lexdens_slope_pre2020  <- avg_slope(fit_lexdens, yr_min, 2020)
  lexdens_slope_post2020 <- avg_slope(fit_lexdens, 2020, yr_max)

  cat("\n--- Lexical density, pre-2020 slope (", yr_min, "-2020) ---\n")
  print(round(lexdens_slope_pre2020, 4))
  cat("\n--- Lexical density, post-2020 slope (2020-", yr_max, ") ---\n")
  print(round(lexdens_slope_post2020, 4))
}
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# 1) One row per study_id
# =========================================================
study_lookup <- study %>%
  transmute(
    study_id,
    year = as.integer(year),
    discipline = str_squish(as.character(discipline)),
    methodology = str_squish(as.character(methodology_category)),
    guideline_type = str_squish(as.character(guideline_extension))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    guideline_type = tolower(guideline_type),
    guideline_type = case_when(
      guideline_type %in% c("original", "origional") ~ "Original",
      guideline_type == "update" ~ "Update",
      guideline_type == "extension" ~ "Extension",
      TRUE ~ str_to_title(guideline_type)
    ),
    discipline = na_if(discipline, ""),
    methodology = na_if(methodology, ""),
    guideline_type = na_if(guideline_type, "")
  ) %>%
  distinct(study_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# =========================================================
# 2) Concept-level base data
# =========================================================

concept_sets_base <- concept %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(study_id),
    !is.na(standardised_reporting_item_elements)
  ) %>%
  left_join(study_lookup, by = "study_id") %>%
  mutate(
    standardised_reporting_item_elements =
      str_squish(as.character(standardised_reporting_item_elements)),
    guideline = as.character(study_id)
  ) %>%
  filter(standardised_reporting_item_elements != "") %>%
  distinct(
    guideline,
    study_id,
    discipline,
    methodology,
    guideline_type,
    standardised_reporting_item_elements
  )

# =========================================================
# 3) Helper: build set list for a grouping variable
# =========================================================

make_set_list <- function(data, group_var) {
  group_var <- rlang::ensym(group_var)

  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!group_var)) %>%
    group_by(!!group_var) %>%
    summarise(
      concepts = list(sort(unique(standardised_reporting_item_elements))),
      n_concepts = n_distinct(standardised_reporting_item_elements),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(group = !!group_var)
}

# =========================================================
# 4) Helper: pairwise Jaccard overlap
# =========================================================

calc_pairwise_overlap <- function(set_list) {
  if (nrow(set_list) < 2) {
    return(
      tibble(
        group_1 = character(),
        group_2 = character(),
        n_1 = integer(),
        n_2 = integer(),
        shared_n = integer(),
        unique_1_n = integer(),
        unique_2_n = integer(),
        jaccard = numeric()
      )
    )
  }

  combn(seq_len(nrow(set_list)), 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    map_dfr(function(idx) {
      a <- set_list$concepts[[idx[1]]]
      b <- set_list$concepts[[idx[2]]]

      inter <- intersect(a, b)
      union_ab <- union(a, b)

      tibble(
        group_1 = as.character(set_list$group[idx[1]]),
        group_2 = as.character(set_list$group[idx[2]]),
        n_1 = length(a),
        n_2 = length(b),
        shared_n = length(inter),
        unique_1_n = length(setdiff(a, b)),
        unique_2_n = length(setdiff(b, a)),
        jaccard = ifelse(length(union_ab) == 0, NA_real_, length(inter) / length(union_ab))
      )
    })
}

# =========================================================
# 5) Helper: summary stats
# =========================================================

calc_overlap_stats <- function(pairwise_overlap) {
  if (nrow(pairwise_overlap) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        n = 0L,
        mean_jaccard = NA_real_,
        sd_jaccard = NA_real_,
        median_jaccard = NA_real_,
        q1_jaccard = NA_real_,
        q3_jaccard = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  pairwise_overlap %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_jaccard = mean(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_jaccard = sd(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_jaccard = median(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      q1_jaccard = quantile(jaccard, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q3_jaccard = quantile(jaccard, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

# =========================================================
# 6) Helper: formatted summary string
# =========================================================

format_overlap_stats <- function(overlap_stats) {
  overlap_stats %>%
    mutate(
      mean_sd_n = sprintf("%.3f (SD %.3f), n = %d",
                          mean_jaccard, sd_jaccard, n)
    )
}

# =========================================================
# 7) Plot: distribution
# =========================================================

plot_overlap_dist <- function(pairwise_overlap, title_text, fill_col) {
  ggplot(pairwise_overlap, aes(x = jaccard)) +
    geom_histogram(
      bins = 18,
      fill = fill_col,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.4,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
      limits = c(0, 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Pairwise Jaccard overlap",
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0,
        size = 18,
        margin = margin(b = 12)
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 12, r = 12, b = 12, l = 12),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# =========================================================
# 8) Plot: full heatmap (with Jaccard colour legend)
# =========================================================

plot_overlap_heatmap <- function(set_list, pairwise_overlap, title_text, high_col) {
  group_order <- set_list %>%
    arrange(desc(n_concepts)) %>%
    pull(group) %>%
    as.character()

  heatmap_data <- bind_rows(
    pairwise_overlap,
    pairwise_overlap %>%
      transmute(
        group_1 = group_2,
        group_2 = group_1,
        n_1 = n_2,
        n_2 = n_1,
        shared_n = shared_n,
        unique_1_n = unique_2_n,
        unique_2_n = unique_1_n,
        jaccard = jaccard
      ),
    tibble(
      group_1 = as.character(set_list$group),
      group_2 = as.character(set_list$group),
      n_1 = set_list$n_concepts,
      n_2 = set_list$n_concepts,
      shared_n = set_list$n_concepts,
      unique_1_n = 0,
      unique_2_n = 0,
      jaccard = 1
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      group_1 = factor(as.character(group_1), levels = group_order),
      group_2 = factor(as.character(group_2), levels = rev(group_order))
    )

  ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = group_1, y = group_2, fill = jaccard)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#f7f7f7",
      high = high_col,
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
      name = "Jaccard\noverlap",
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        barheight = unit(4, "cm"),
        ticks.colour = "black",
        frame.colour = "black",
        title.position = "top"
      )
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0,
        size = 18,
        margin = margin(b = 14)
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 55,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1,
        size = 10.5,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 10.5,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 18, b = 40, l = 40)
    )
}

# =========================================================
# 9) Plot: top-20 guideline heatmap (with Jaccard colour legend)
# =========================================================

plot_topN_guidelines_heatmap <- function(set_list, pairwise_overlap, title_text, high_col, top_n = 20) {
  if (nrow(set_list) == 0 || nrow(pairwise_overlap) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  mean_overlap <- bind_rows(
    pairwise_overlap %>% transmute(group = group_1, other = group_2, jaccard = jaccard),
    pairwise_overlap %>% transmute(group = group_2, other = group_1, jaccard = jaccard)
  ) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(mean_jaccard = mean(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_jaccard))

  top_groups <- mean_overlap %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    pull(group) %>%
    as.character()

  top_groups <- top_groups[top_groups %in% set_list$group]

  if (length(top_groups) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  heatmap_data <- bind_rows(
    pairwise_overlap,
    pairwise_overlap %>%
      transmute(
        group_1 = group_2,
        group_2 = group_1,
        n_1 = n_2,
        n_2 = n_1,
        shared_n = shared_n,
        unique_1_n = unique_2_n,
        unique_2_n = unique_1_n,
        jaccard = jaccard
      ),
    tibble(
      group_1 = as.character(set_list$group),
      group_2 = as.character(set_list$group),
      n_1 = set_list$n_concepts,
      n_2 = set_list$n_concepts,
      shared_n = set_list$n_concepts,
      unique_1_n = 0,
      unique_2_n = 0,
      jaccard = 1
    )
  ) %>%
    filter(
      as.character(group_1) %in% top_groups,
      as.character(group_2) %in% top_groups
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      group_1 = factor(as.character(group_1), levels = top_groups),
      group_2 = factor(as.character(group_2), levels = rev(top_groups))
    )

  ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = group_1, y = group_2, fill = jaccard)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#f7f7f7",
      high = high_col,
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
      name = "Jaccard\noverlap",
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        barheight = unit(3.2, "cm"),
        ticks.colour = "black",
        frame.colour = "black",
        title.position = "top"
      )
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0,
        size = 16,
        margin = margin(b = 12)
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1,
        size = 8.5,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 8.5,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 15, b = 35, l = 15)
    )
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, filename_stub, width, height) {
  ggsave(
    filename = here::here("figures", paste0(filename_stub, ".png")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 500,
    bg = "white"
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = here::here("figures", paste0(filename_stub, ".pdf")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
}

# =========================================================
```
```{r}
# A) Concept prevalence: how many groups contain each concept
#    (core vs peripheral concepts) — run per grouping level
# =========================================================

concept_prevalence <- function(set_list) {
  set_list %>%
    tidyr::unnest(concepts) %>%
    rename(concept = concepts) %>%
    count(concept, name = "n_groups_present") %>%
    mutate(
      pct_groups_present = n_groups_present / n_distinct(set_list$group) * 100
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_groups_present))
}

guideline_concept_prevalence  <- concept_prevalence(guideline_set_list)
discipline_concept_prevalence <- concept_prevalence(discipline_set_list)
method_concept_prevalence     <- concept_prevalence(method_set_list)
type_concept_prevalence       <- concept_prevalence(type_set_list)

# Classify concepts as core (>=75% of groups), common (25-75%), peripheral (<25%)
classify_prevalence <- function(prevalence_df) {
  prevalence_df %>%
    mutate(
      tier = case_when(
        pct_groups_present >= 75 ~ "Core (>=75% groups)",
        pct_groups_present >= 25 ~ "Common (25-75% groups)",
        TRUE ~ "Peripheral (<25% groups)"
      )
    )
}

guideline_concept_prevalence  <- classify_prevalence(guideline_concept_prevalence)
discipline_concept_prevalence <- classify_prevalence(discipline_concept_prevalence)
method_concept_prevalence     <- classify_prevalence(method_concept_prevalence)
type_concept_prevalence       <- classify_prevalence(type_concept_prevalence)

readr::write_csv(guideline_concept_prevalence,  here::here("figures", "guideline_concept_prevalence.csv"))
readr::write_csv(discipline_concept_prevalence, here::here("figures", "discipline_concept_prevalence.csv"))
readr::write_csv(method_concept_prevalence,     here::here("figures", "methodology_concept_prevalence.csv"))
readr::write_csv(type_concept_prevalence,       here::here("figures", "guideline_type_concept_prevalence.csv"))

# =========================================================
# B) Concept-level contribution to pairwise overlap
#    (which concepts most often appear in shared vs unique sets)
# =========================================================

calc_concept_contributions <- function(set_list) {
  if (nrow(set_list) < 2) return(tibble())

  pairs <- combn(seq_len(nrow(set_list)), 2, simplify = FALSE)

  purrr::map_dfr(pairs, function(idx) {
    a <- set_list$concepts[[idx[1]]]
    b <- set_list$concepts[[idx[2]]]
    shared  <- intersect(a, b)
    unique_a <- setdiff(a, b)
    unique_b <- setdiff(b, a)

    bind_rows(
      tibble(concept = shared,   role = "shared"),
      tibble(concept = unique_a, role = "unique"),
      tibble(concept = unique_b, role = "unique")
    )
  }) %>%
    count(concept, role) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = role, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(
      total = shared + unique,
      pct_shared = shared / total * 100
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(shared))
}

guideline_concept_contrib  <- calc_concept_contributions(guideline_set_list)
discipline_concept_contrib <- calc_concept_contributions(discipline_set_list)
method_concept_contrib     <- calc_concept_contributions(method_set_list)
type_concept_contrib       <- calc_concept_contributions(type_set_list)

readr::write_csv(guideline_concept_contrib,  here::here("figures", "guideline_concept_contribution.csv"))
readr::write_csv(discipline_concept_contrib, here::here("figures", "discipline_concept_contribution.csv"))
readr::write_csv(method_concept_contrib,     here::here("figures", "methodology_concept_contribution.csv"))
readr::write_csv(type_concept_contrib,       here::here("figures", "guideline_type_concept_contribution.csv"))

# Top drivers of similarity (highest pct_shared, appears in most pairs)
top_shared_concepts <- function(contrib_df, n = 15) {
  contrib_df %>% arrange(desc(shared)) %>% slice_head(n = n)
}

# Top drivers of divergence (concepts almost always unique, never shared)
top_unique_concepts <- function(contrib_df, n = 15) {
  contrib_df %>% filter(shared == 0) %>% arrange(desc(unique)) %>% slice_head(n = n)
}

guideline_top_shared  <- top_shared_concepts(guideline_concept_contrib)
guideline_top_unique  <- top_unique_concepts(guideline_concept_contrib)

# =========================================================
# C) MDS ordination of guidelines using 1 - Jaccard distance
# =========================================================

build_jaccard_dist_matrix <- function(set_list, pairwise_overlap) {
  groups <- as.character(set_list$group)
  n <- length(groups)
  m <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames = list(groups, groups))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairwise_overlap))) {
    g1 <- pairwise_overlap$group_1[i]
    g2 <- pairwise_overlap$group_2[i]
    d  <- 1 - pairwise_overlap$jaccard[i]
    m[g1, g2] <- d
    m[g2, g1] <- d
  }
  as.dist(m)
}

guideline_dist <- build_jaccard_dist_matrix(guideline_set_list, guideline_pairwise_overlap)
guideline_mds  <- cmdscale(guideline_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)

guideline_mds_df <- as_tibble(guideline_mds$points, .name_repair = "unique") %>%
  rename(MDS1 = 1, MDS2 = 2) %>%
  mutate(guideline = rownames(guideline_mds$points)) %>%
  left_join(
    study_lookup %>% distinct(study_id, discipline, methodology, guideline_type) %>%
      mutate(guideline = as.character(study_id)),
    by = "guideline"
  )

variance_explained <- guideline_mds$eig[1:2] / sum(guideline_mds$eig[guideline_mds$eig > 0]) * 100

readr::write_csv(guideline_mds_df, here::here("figures", "guideline_mds_coordinates.csv"))

mds_plot <- ggplot(guideline_mds_df, aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, color = methodology)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "MDS of checklists by concept overlap (Jaccard distance)",
    x = sprintf("Dim 1 (%.1f%%)", variance_explained[1]),
    y = sprintf("Dim 2 (%.1f%%)", variance_explained[2]),
    color = "Methodology"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

save_plot_both(mds_plot, "guideline_mds_by_methodology", 8.5, 6.5)
```

```{r}
study_lookup <- study %>%
  transmute(
    study_id,
    year = as.integer(year),
    discipline = str_squish(as.character(discipline)),

    ),

  ) %>%

    !is.na(standardised_reporting_item_elements)
  ) %>%

      str_squish(as.character(standardised_reporting_item_elements)),

make_set_list <- function(data, group_var) {
  group_var <- rlang::ensym(group_var)

  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!group_var)) %>%
    group_by(!!group_var) %>%
    summarise(
      concepts = list(sort(unique(standardised_reporting_item_elements))),
      n_concepts = n_distinct(standardised_reporting_item_elements),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(group = !!group_var)
}

calc_pairwise_overlap <- function(set_list) {
  if (nrow(set_list) < 2) {
    return(
      tibble(
        group_1 = character(),
        group_2 = character(),
        n_1 = integer(),
        n_2 = integer(),
        shared_n = integer(),
        unique_1_n = integer(),
        unique_2_n = integer(),
        jaccard = numeric()
      )
    )
  }

  combn(seq_len(nrow(set_list)), 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    map_dfr(function(idx) {
      a <- set_list$concepts[[idx[1]]]
      b <- set_list$concepts[[idx[2]]]

      inter <- intersect(a, b)
      union_ab <- union(a, b)

      tibble(
        group_1 = as.character(set_list$group[idx[1]]),
        group_2 = as.character(set_list$group[idx[2]]),
        n_1 = length(a),
        n_2 = length(b),
        shared_n = length(inter),
        unique_1_n = length(setdiff(a, b)),
        unique_2_n = length(setdiff(b, a)),
        jaccard = ifelse(length(union_ab) == 0, NA_real_, length(inter) / length(union_ab))
      )
    })
}

make_heatmap_data <- function(set_list, pairwise_overlap) {
  bind_rows(
    pairwise_overlap,
    pairwise_overlap %>%
      transmute(
        group_1 = group_2,
        group_2 = group_1,
        n_1 = n_2,
        n_2 = n_1,
        shared_n = shared_n,
        unique_1_n = unique_2_n,
        unique_2_n = unique_1_n,
        jaccard = jaccard
      ),
    tibble(
      group_1 = as.character(set_list$group),
      group_2 = as.character(set_list$group),
      n_1 = set_list$n_concepts,
      n_2 = set_list$n_concepts,
      shared_n = set_list$n_concepts,
      unique_1_n = 0,
      unique_2_n = 0,
      jaccard = 1
    )
  )
}

compute_guideline_mean_overlap <- function(pairwise_df) {
  bind_rows(
    pairwise_df %>%
      transmute(group = group_1, jaccard = jaccard),
    pairwise_df %>%
      transmute(group = group_2, jaccard = jaccard)
  ) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(mean_jaccard = mean(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_jaccard))
}

plot_topN_guidelines_heatmap <- function(set_list, pairwise_overlap, top_n = 20, high_col = "#5c8f7a") {
  mean_overlap <- compute_guideline_mean_overlap(pairwise_overlap)

  top_groups <- mean_overlap %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    pull(group) %>%
    as.character()

  top_groups <- top_groups[top_groups %in% set_list$group]

  heatmap_data <- make_heatmap_data(set_list, pairwise_overlap) %>%
    filter(
      as.character(group_1) %in% top_groups,
      as.character(group_2) %in% top_groups
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      group_1 = factor(as.character(group_1), levels = top_groups),
      group_2 = factor(as.character(group_2), levels = rev(top_groups))
    )

  ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = group_1, y = group_2, fill = jaccard)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.45) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#f7f7f7",
      high = high_col,
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
      name = "Jaccard\noverlap",
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = unit(0.45, "cm"),
        barheight = unit(3.4, "cm"),
        ticks.colour = "black",
        frame.colour = "black",
        title.position = "top"
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = "b) Mean pairwise concept overlap",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      caption = "Top 20 reporting guidelines with the highest mean overlap"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1,
        size = 7.5,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 8.2,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(color = "black", margin = margin(t = 8)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black", margin = margin(r = 8)),
      axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
      axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 12.5,
        face = "bold",
        color = "black",
        hjust = 0
      ),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.caption.position = "plot",
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 9.5,
        face = "italic",
        color = "grey35",
        hjust = 0,
        margin = margin(t = 6)
      ),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 6)
    )
}

guideline_set_list <- make_set_list(concept_sets_base, guideline)
guideline_pairwise_overlap <- calc_pairwise_overlap(guideline_set_list)

plot_b_overlap <- plot_topN_guidelines_heatmap(
  guideline_set_list,

  top_n = 20,

)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(tidybayes)

## ---- 1. Join (same as before) ----
model_data <- concepts_per_item %>%
  inner_join(item_metrics, by = "checklist_item_id") %>%
  select(checklist_item_id, study_id, n_concepts, mattr_10, lexical_density, token_count)

## ---- 2. Standardize predictors ----
model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(
    mattr_z = as.numeric(scale(mattr_10)),
    lexdens_z = as.numeric(scale(lexical_density)),
    log_tokens_z = as.numeric(scale(log(token_count)))
  )

## ---- 3. Priors (same structure for both models) ----
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  prior(gamma(0.01, 0.01), class = "shape")
)

## ---- 4a. Model 1: MATTR ----
nb_brm_mattr <- brm(
  n_concepts ~ mattr_z + log_tokens_z + (1 | study_id),
  data = model_data,
  family = negbinomial(),
  prior = priors,
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)

## ---- 4b. Model 2: Lexical density ----
nb_brm_lexdens <- brm(
  n_concepts ~ lexdens_z + log_tokens_z + (1 | study_id),
  data = model_data,
  family = negbinomial(),
  prior = priors,
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)

## ---- 5. Diagnostics for both ----
summary(nb_brm_mattr)
summary(nb_brm_lexdens)

pp_check(nb_brm_mattr, ndraws = 100)
pp_check(nb_brm_lexdens, ndraws = 100)

## ---- 6. IRRs for both ----
mattr_irr <- nb_brm_mattr %>%
  spread_draws(b_mattr_z) %>%
  mutate(irr = exp(b_mattr_z)) %>%
  median_qi(irr, .width = c(0.80, 0.95)) %>%
  mutate(term = "mattr_10")

lexdens_irr <- nb_brm_lexdens %>%
  spread_draws(b_lexdens_z) %>%
  mutate(irr = exp(b_lexdens_z)) %>%
  median_qi(irr, .width = c(0.80, 0.95)) %>%
  mutate(term = "lexical_density")

bind_rows(mattr_irr, lexdens_irr)

## ---- 7. Conditional effects plots ----
conditional_effects(nb_brm_mattr, effects = "mattr_z")
conditional_effects(nb_brm_lexdens, effects = "lexdens_z")
```

```{r}
concepts_by_section <- concept %>%
```
